references.text: Jesus warns against false messiahs and prophets who will lead many astray
Jesus mentions that many false prophets will arise and lead many astray
Jesus continues to warn against believing those who say the Messiah is here or there, for His return will be obvious to all
Joel prophesies about wonderful signs from God in the last days, which can be related to warnings about false signs and wonders
Isaiah warns against seeking guidance from mediums and fortune-tellers, and urges holding fast to God's word, which can be seen in connection with warnings against false messiahs
Daniel prophesies about a time of great trials and that many will be purified, which can be related to warnings about deception
Revelation warns about false signs and wonders that will lead people astray, performed by the image of the beast
Revelation mentions the beast and the false prophet who perform signs to deceive those who take the mark of the beast
